newsitem.title: USA: Bond sales total $580 mln for Thursday - update.
newsitem.headline: Bond sales total $580 mln for Thursday - update.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Thursday, May 22 are expected to total $580 million in 23 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
A $160 million Florida deal was announced late Wednesday.
Negotiated offerings total $353 million in seven sales, with a $209 million Metropolitian Washington Airport, D.C., deal through Lehman Brothers is topping the list.
On the competitive side, 16 sales totaling $227 million are on the schedule. A $160 million Florida issue at 1100 EDT is the largest.
An additional two sales totaling $23 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues Thursday depending on market conditions.
